assessment_policy: Correctness, concrete contribution, priority and fertility remain separate. Matched-cost acquisition synthesis, the emission-family counterexample and exact renewal/retention quotient are contributions enabled by known tools, not dismissed because conditioning and stochastic lumping are classical.

branch_additions.title: Renewable knowledge interfaces under action-dependent memory selection
branch_additions.hypothesis: Fresh acquisition can restore an invariant diagnostic interface; retaining exact bits does not in general preserve that family after actions, resources and survival select the stored signals.
branch_additions.reactivation_trigger: A recurrent evaluator reuses its acquisition law after a change from fresh sensing to physical retention, or diagnosis is refreshed only after the intervention it is meant to trigger.
branch_additions.minimal_test: Same v16 task, source hash, budget and bank. Four equally priced acquisition rules times sixteen physical routing programs, full rational kernels, independent fault oracle and a static-health counterexample.
branch_additions.acceptance_gate: Exact same-task comparison, reoptimization as well as fixed-controller results, a witness outside the old emission family and an independently verified replacement quotient.
branch_additions.contribution: Executed64-program comparison; ideal retention with fixed contingent control yields .8958752 versus .9174768 for renewal; 4096 exact quotient rows; a selection witness invalidates even a source-health mixture after retention, with no health change required.

branch_updates.evidence: Renewal closes the prior stochastic interface; retention can leave its entire exchangeable emission family. A48-state physical quotient remains exact for all64 programs.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Costed selective acquisition based solely on actual evidence and finite physical memory, not known health or an evaluator posterior.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: The evaluator keeps recalibrating retained bits by a fresh sensor law or invents a readout of hidden health.
branch_updates.minimal_test: One small acquisition selector, same resource ledger, complete loss/cost frontier and separating history.

branch_updates.evidence: The exact physical routing and acquisition tables must be reoptimized together; result comparisons report fixed and best-per-library policies.
branch_updates.remaining_gate: Price and fault the shared observation-selection/update interface; do not infer energy advantage from the matched-price control experiment.
branch_updates.dead_end_trigger: A claimed improvement changes the physical task, grants a hidden signal or omits a cheaper whole program.
branch_updates.minimal_test: Preserve one model and compare two genuinely priced complete libraries; derive a witness and a bound.

rejected_additions.claim: Perfectly retaining a diagnostic preserves its original emission law, possibly by retaining its source-health label.
rejected_additions.reason: Actions, balance and surviving reweight the stored words. A retained live distribution gives unequal011/101 masses although every original source-health emission is exchangeable; a static-health, perfect-selector support example independently refutes the mixture representation.

rejected_additions.claim: At equal acquisition price, observing only after maintenance is necessarily better than observing after a skipped maintenance decision.
rejected_additions.reason: In the frozen recurrent fixture, fixed-contingent survival is .8874864 versus .9164918; reoptimizing the entire routing library gives .9115513 versus .9164918. A stale healthy report can delay both the repair and the new observation needed to trigger it. This is a scoped counterexample, not the opposite universal ordering.
